structure_policy_rationale: 参考主题中 bilibili 和 douban 的案例表明，即使是复杂的图形或文字，也必须保留其原始拓扑结构。Paipai 的图标由清晰的几何剪影组成，完全符合‘preserve_major_structure’的条件。必须将原本的2D剪影直接转化为具有厚度的3D冰雕实体，严禁改变触角的数量、弯曲度或小人的姿态，以确保用户在去色后仍能通过轮廓识别应用。
preserve: 下方巨大的黑色弧形头部剪影及其两根弯曲的触角
上方悬浮的小人角色的椭圆身体与四肢动态
上下两个元素之间的相对位置比例（小人位于头部正上方）
原图标的整体外轮廓剪影（Silhouette）
头部触角的数量和弯曲形态
上方小人的肢体动作和身体比例
must_preserve: 下方巨大的黑色弧形头部剪影及其两根弯曲的触角
上方悬浮的小人角色的椭圆身体与四肢动态
上下两个元素之间的相对位置比例（小人位于头部正上方）
原图标的整体外轮廓剪影（Silhouette）
头部触角的数量和弯曲形态
上方小人的肢体动作和身体比例
主体与背景的高对比度边缘（通过高光界定）
recompose_allowed: 将原本的纯黑/纯黄填充替换为半透明冰晶材质
在冰块内部添加气泡、裂纹或雪花纹理以增加细节
将锐利的矢量边缘打磨为圆润的冰块边缘（Chamfered edges）
增加底部的接触阴影和少量碎冰/水坑细节
restyle: 强制去色：将原黑色主体和黄色小人统一转换为半透明浅冰蓝色（Cyan/Ice Blue）
材质化：赋予表面高光泽、湿润感，内部嵌入微小气泡和雪花纹理
体积化：将2D扁平剪影挤压为具有Z轴厚度的3D实体，边缘圆润化处理
decorate: 底部增加软性接触阴影（Contact Shadow）
基座周围添加少量融化的水渍或碎冰细节
表面添加冷凝水珠和高光反射点
forbid: 禁止保留原始的亮黄色和深黑色填充（必须转为冰蓝/透白）
禁止将小人简化为抽象符号或移除
禁止使用不透明的塑料或金属质感
禁止改变触角的方向或数量
禁止使用深色或复杂背景，必须为纯白/极淡冷灰背景
generation_brief: 3D icon of Paipai logo made of translucent light blue ice. Structure: large rounded head silhouette with two curved antennae at bottom, small cute character floating directly above. Material: glossy wet ice, internal bubbles/snowflakes, subsurface scattering. Background: pure white. Lighting: top-front studio light, sharp specular highlights. Base: soft contact shadow, small melting puddles/ice shards. Strictly preserve original silhouette proportions and spatial relationship.
color_application: Apply theme's 'Dominant Translucent Cyan/Light Ice Blue' to both the head and the floating character. Remove original black and yellow colors entirely. Use pure white for highlights and deep blue/grey for internal shadows/refraction.
stroke_application: Eliminate original flat vector strokes. Define forms through 3D volume, lighting contrasts, and refractive edges. Ensure edges are smooth, rounded, and chamfered to mimic eroded ice.
composition_application: Center the composite ice sculpture (head + floating character) on the canvas. Occupy 60-70% of vertical space. Maintain the vertical stacking arrangement. Anchor the object with a subtle ground plane interaction (shadow/puddle).
identity_application: Preserve the unique topology of the crab-like head (antennae curvature) and the specific pose of the floating sprite. Recognizability relies on the exact geometric silhouette and the relative positioning of the two elements, rendered in uniform ice material.
fidelity_constraints: Subject must be translucent ice/crystal, not opaque plastic.
Color palette strictly limited to ice blues, whites, and deep blue shadows.
Original silhouette geometry must be strictly preserved.
Must have physical grounding (shadow/puddle) on white background.
negative_constraints: No floating objects without contact shadows.
No distortion of the antennae or character limbs.
